dedupe_keys.name: a dataset of storm surge reconstructions in the western north pacific using cnn

description: A dataset of storm surge reconstructions in the Western North Pacific using CNN is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Wen Dang et al. The relatively short duration of available tide gauge records poses challenges for conducting statistical analyses of storm surges in the Western North Pacific. To address this issue, we employ a convolutional neural network model to reconstruct the maximum daily storm surge at 160 tide gauges from 1900 to 2010 in the Western North Pacific. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
